import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,subprocess,sys,base64
lane=Path.cwd(); writer=str(lane/'write_lane.py')
def write(n,s):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',writer,n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True); assert r.returncode==0
ids=set(json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids']); found=[]
root=Path('/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus')
for p in sorted(root.glob('mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl')):
 data=p.read_bytes(); ch=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
 for i,raw in enumerate(data.splitlines(keepends=True),1):
  obj=json.loads(raw)
  if obj.get('mathdb_id') not in ids: continue
  print(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False)); print('KEYS',list(obj))
  k=next(k for k in ['statement','statement_text','problem_statement'] if k in obj)

  token=m.group(1); dec=obj[k].encode()
  stem='originals/'+str(obj['mathdb_id'])
  write(stem+'.raw.jsonl',raw.decode());write(stem+'.token.txt',token.decode());write(stem+'.statement.txt',dec.decode())
  found.append({'id':obj['mathdb_id'],'chunk':str(p),'chunk_sha256':ch,'line':i,'raw_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'newline':raw.endswith(b'\n'),'token_sha256':hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest(),'decoded_sha256':hashlib.sha256(dec).hexdigest()})
assert len(found)==20
write('literal-provenance.json',json.dumps(found,indent=2))
